notes.title: 🚀 Major Update: Multiplayer Mode & Physics Overhaul!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce a huge new update packed with exciting features and improvements based on your feedback!
🧠 Smarter Physics, Easier Jumps
Jump timing has been rebalanced — it’s now easier and more intuitive to master pogo jumps.

Increased jump height gives you more freedom and vertical mobility.

These changes make movement feel smoother and more satisfying for both new and experienced players.
🌍 Map Updates & Improved Gameplay Elements
We’ve tweaked and upgraded several interactive objects across the map:

Bouncy mushrooms

Falling sticks near waterfalls

Moving platforms

Pinecones dropping from trees

Swaying rocks hanging on chains

…and more surprises waiting to be discovered!

These changes not only add variety but also improve the overall flow and challenge of the level design.
🔗 New Feature: Multiplayer Mode with Rope Mechanics
Play with 1 to 4 players online!

Use the grappling rope to connect with teammates for fun, chaotic moments — or switch off player collisions and go for a serious, competitive climb.

Whether you’re cooperating or racing to the top, the multiplayer mode adds a whole new layer of excitement.
[hr][/hr]
Let us know what you think of the new changes, and don’t forget to share your best multiplayer fails (or wins)!
See you at the top of the mountain! 🏔️💥
